content_zh:
第512章再相见
秦优轻飘飘飞到墨微尘身后，来回游荡。
“啧啧啧，拜托~身为师父~~徒弟渡劫当然要提前准备啊~~~”
墨微尘无奈：“……怎么哪都是你跑的最快。”
秦优：“没办法~谁让我不靠谱呢~”
墨微尘：“……够了。”
柳望秋与柳知夏毫不意外，连哭嚎的声音都没卡壳，只抱着墨微尘继续哭。
“诶呀呀，墨峰主，”秦优贴在墨微尘身后，继续阴阳怪气道，“该不会，你只把温言当自己弟子吧？早就把人家姐弟俩给忘掉了吧？”
此话一出，柳望秋和柳知夏哀嚎的声音总算顿了顿，他们二人对视一眼，随后爆发出了更嘹亮的哭声。
“呜呜呜，我们师父不稀罕我们……呜呜呜……”
“呜呜呜，师父想让我们死，呜呜呜……”
墨微尘心头一跳：“胡言乱语！”
俩弟子哭的厉害，几个老家伙还在旁边看热闹，墨微尘真是那叫一个手忙脚乱：“我不是我没有，我、我、我、我真的，我只是……”
可墨微尘根本就不会哄孩子，也哄不了年纪这么大的孩子。
最后，墨微尘没办法，只能随手从自己空间里揪出一个空间戒指扔给了姐弟俩。
“拿着吧，就当是我补偿你们的，别哭了。”墨微尘扶额，语气疲惫。
灵宝到手的那一刻，柳望秋与柳知夏非常有默契地同时止住了哭声。两个小脑袋凑在一起开始查看空间里的灵宝灵物。
“老弟，这个适合你，你拿着！”
“诶？这个我能种活，姐，给我给我！”
“那个丹药给我，我正好快突破了……”

“啊？我也想要，一人半瓶！”
“行！那个匕首给我防身用，长剑我挥不动。”
“好，那长剑我留着，它品阶高，去紫霄峰那边随便找个富点的弟子就能低价卖出去。”
“……”
“真是太赚了，希望温言下次渡劫也在神机峰，还能再坑峰主一把。”
“同意同意，要我说，下次就该在脸上搞点擦伤，峰主给的更多。”
尽数收入耳中的墨微尘：……
他还在这站着呢，能不能稍微演一演。
——————————
柳知夏姐弟俩分完“赃”后，火速起身。
“弟子柳知夏（柳望秋），见过峰主，见过诸位峰主，诸位长老，日安。峰主，您还有要事在身，弟子不便打扰，就此告退！”
content_en:
Chapter 512 See you again
Qin You flew lightly behind Mo Weichen, wandering back and forth.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk, please~ As a master~~ of course the apprentice must prepare in advance~~~"
Mo Weichen was helpless: "...Why are you the fastest runner everywhere?"
Qin You: "I can't help it~ Who makes me unreliable~"
Mo Weichen: "...enough."
Liu Wangqiu and Liu Zhixia were not surprised. They didn't even stop crying and just continued to cry while holding Mo Weichen.
"Hey, Lord Mo," Qin You stood behind Mo Weichen and continued to say in a strange tone, "Could it be that you only regard Wen Yan as your disciple? You have already forgotten about the siblings, right?"
As soon as these words came out, the wailing sounds of Liu Wangqiu and Liu Zhixia finally paused. The two of them looked at each other, and then burst into louder cries.
"Wuwuwu, our master doesn't care about us... Wuwuwu..."
"Wuwuwu, Master wants us to die, Wuwuwu..."
Mo Weichen's heart skipped a beat: "Nonsense!"
The two disciples were crying hard, and a few old guys were still watching the fun. Mo Weichen was really in a hurry: "It's not that I don't have it, I, I, I, I really, I just..."
But Mo Weichen didn't know how to coax children, and he couldn't coax such an old child.
In the end, Mo Weichen had no choice but to pull out a space ring from his own space and throw it to the siblings.
"Take it, think of it as my compensation for you, don't cry." Mo Weichen held his forehead and spoke in a tired tone.
The moment the Lingbao was obtained, Liu Wangqiu and Liu Zhixia stopped crying at the same time with a tacit understanding. The two little heads came together and began to check the spiritual treasures and spiritual objects in the space.
"Brother, this suits you, take it!"
"Eh? I can do this, sister, give it to me!"
"Give me that elixir, I'm about to break through..."
"Ah? I want it too, half a bottle for each person!"
"Okay! Give me the dagger for self-defense. I can't swing the long sword."
"Okay, I'll keep that long sword. It's of high grade. I can just go to Zixiao Peak and find a richer disciple and sell it at a low price."
"..."
"It's so profitable. I hope Wen Yan will be at Shenji Peak next time he undergoes a tribulation, and he can trick the peak master again."
"I agree, if you ask me, you should get some scratches on your face next time. The Peak Master will give you more."
Mo Mochen, who had everything in his ears:...
He is still standing here, can he act a little bit?
——————————
After the Liu Zhixia siblings finished dividing the "stolen", they stood up quickly.
"Disciple Liu Zhixia (Liu Wangqiu), I have met the Peak Master, I have met all the Peak Masters, elders, good day. Peak Master, you have something important to do, and it is inconvenient for the disciples to disturb you, so I will leave now!"
